The source URL uses a fixed commit hash (4add45239a03960aa36de6fef326ee1b753e8ec9), ensuring reproducibility and integrity, despite the `sha256sums` being set to 'SKIP' — which is acceptable for VCS sources in AUR as long as the commit is pinned, which it is.

This change is minor and does not introduce suspicious behavior. The build() function uses standard CMake invocations with explicitly disabled features (demos, tests, plugins, Qt, GPU support), focusing on building only the necessary shared libraries and tools. Installation is handled via a helper function `_install`, which safely moves files from a staged directory (`fakeinstall`) to the package directory.

The `package_ajantv2-dkms` function handles DKMS module packaging, which is expected for kernel modules. It runs `make dkms-pkg` after generating a version header, then copies the resulting module sources into `/usr/src` under a DKMS layout. It also installs a modules-load configuration file. All operations are consistent with standard DKMS packaging practices. No network requests, dynamic downloads, or obfuscated commands are present. The code does not exfiltrate data, execute remote code, or modify unrelated system components.

While the source is a VCS checkout with SKIPped checksums (normal for git sources), the fixed commit ensures trust in the checked-out revision. No post-build network calls, `curl`/`wget`, `eval`, or base64 decoding is used. The package installs only its own files and required configurations. All actions align with the stated purpose: providing open-source SDK and driver support for AJA video hardware.
</details>
